_comment: Curated Browse-tab model catalog fetched by installed Artha apps (packages/app/src/llm/modelCatalog.ts). Editing this file updates every installed app within ~6h — no release needed. Keep entries honest: ramRequired gates a warning chip, minOllamaVersion is a display hint. Mirror meaningful changes into BUNDLED_CATALOG (the offline fallback).
